title: Assumption Record (ASM)
description: An unverified hypothesis, belief, or provisional premise underpinning normative spec elements.

status.description: Epistemic lifecycle status. When 'promoted', promoted_to must reference at least one FCT record.

confidence.description: Estimated probability (0.0 to 1.0) that this assumption holds true prior to validation.

risk.description: Severity of impact on dependent requirements/architecture if this assumption is false.

validation_plan.description: Actionable method to test or verify this assumption (e.g., spike, benchmark, stakeholder sign-off).

validated_by.description: Validation records (VAL-xxxx) that tested this assumption.

promoted_to.description: Fact records (FCT-xxxx) minted when this assumption was validated or refined.
